thread:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up 10: NorthGrid renewal showing procurement friction. They changed signer and want a split invoice (Platform vs. Services). Asked for an updated pricing summary and explicit invoice lines.
Raj Patel: Got it. Do they want term shortened? 9mo vs 12mo will change proration and the SOW.
Mia Chen: Procurement prefers 9mo to line up with their fiscal close. They also want a PO for the platform charge and CC for the one-time services fees.
Omar Ruiz: Mixed payment okay? Finance should be fine with PO for subscription and CC for professional services. @Lucy confirm.
Lucy Nguyen: We can accept split payments but require the SOW and invoice line items separated. Also need the customer's legal entity name and VAT number for EU billing.
Priya Sinha: Legal note: if the signer changed we need new signatory name, title, email, and a delegated signing authority if their org requires it. Short amendment for 9mo term + signer block will be needed.
Raj Patel: I can grab the signer contact now. @Mia can you draft a one-page payment & billing summary I can share? Keep it super concise.
Mia Chen: Will do. Draft in ~25m. Also capturing feedback: they asked for clearer onboarding milestones and a single enablement owner. I propose offering a 1-hour kickoff + 3 milestone check-ins. Thoughts?
Omar Ruiz: Agreed. Recommend we add a SOC2 readout and dedicated CSM for first 90 days to reduce renewal risk.
Lucy Nguyen: Add a line for invoicing cadence. Procurement asked for monthly platform billing. If they want net terms, that needs approval.
Priya Sinha: I'll prepare a brief amendment template to cover the 9mo term and delegated signer clause. Can someone paste current contract & proposed SOW summary here?
Mia Chen: SOW summary (for thread):
````
Platform seats: 200 seats, monthly billing, $0.XX per seat
Professional services: Onboarding + integration, one-time fee $25,000, billed on CC
Enablement: Kickoff (1h) + 3 milestone reviews (wk2, wk6, wk12)
SLA: Standard (99.9% uptime)
Billing notes: Platform invoiced monthly via PO; Services billed once on CC; clear invoice separation requested by procurement
````
Mia Chen: @Raj I'll send signer info and procurement contact after my call. Planning to include enablement options and an explicit split-invoice note in the payment summary.
Raj Patel: I'll ask procurement for PO ETA. If PO arrives within 3 business days we can proceed without delaying onboarding.
Lucy Nguyen: Once we have PO + signer/legal entity + VAT, finance will generate two invoice templates and a PDF with payment instructions.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0a1b2c). Recipient: pending_signer@northgrid.com 1: status: waiting for recipient action.
Mia Chen: I'll nudge the signer and procurement. Also capturing enablement owner preference: customer wants a single contact for scheduling. @Omar can you take the kickoff scheduling when contract is finalized?
Omar Ruiz: Yes, assign enablement scheduling to me. I'll propose three milestone slots in the first two weeks to align with their engineers.
Priya Sinha: Amendment template posted below (short): 
- Amend term to 9 months starting on exec date
- Add delegated signer clause (signed delegation doc required)
- Confirm split-invoice lines and payment routing
I'll review before sending to customer.
Mia Chen: Owners: Raj (procurement/PO), Lucy (finance invoicing), Priya (legal/amendment), Omar (enablement scheduling), Mia (customer comms). I'll update thread with PO and signer by EOD.
Mia Chen: Update: procurement said PO will be issued tomorrow AM. Signer reply pending; I have a 10:30 PT call scheduled.
Mia Chen: Update: signer confirmed, delegated signing doc uploaded to shared drive, DocuSign resent to corrected email. PO expected tomorrow morning.
Mia Chen: Final update: PO received 2024-08-16 09:12 UTC (attached). Legal approved amendment, DocuSign completed. Finance to send split invoices Monday. Thanks team! :tada:
